description: Platform Guardian: session opener on startup or /clear (git report + last local session-log entry → session-opener skill), an inspect gate on every prompt and slash command (Ono rule: no work in a project the Ono Project Inspector hasn't inspected, unless the employee types the manager-approval sentence), a session-length signal that suggests the close-out once the context grows large, a write guard (no file changes on a protected branch: main, master, the project's central branch), and a commit-hygiene guard on git add / commit / push (only code goes in unless the employee asks; secrets never; no commit or push on a protected branch).
